Findings: Research corpus for the docs site lives at .planning/docs-site-research/ (15 files, cites at HEAD 3543dc6): per-lane notes + _critic.md arbitrating 10 cross-lane contradictions. Canonical counts: 39 registered tools, 15 default, 24 full-surface-gated, 8 lite; no v1.9.0 or v2.3.0 git tag exists.; warning: twining_verify declares fail_on in its schema (src/tools/verify-tools.ts:40-55) but VerifyEngine never reads it — dead parameter at HEAD; also schema says checks default 'all' while engine default is ['warnings','assembly','drift'] (src/engine/verify.ts:28-29). Docs fix wave aligns the text; the dead param itself needs a code decision.; warning: the dashboard Insights Tool Usage table calls an undefined formatTime() (src/dashboard/public/app.js:1970, never defined since the 6950e26 analytics commit) — statically cannot render rows, error silently swallowed. Docs site will not claim that table works; needs a code fix.; upstream anthropics/claude-code#11927 (project settings.json env not delivered to plugin MCP servers) still OPEN, repro 2026-08-19 on CC 2.1.235 — docs must teach exported-env TWINING_PROJECT placement, not the settings.json snippet at README.md:230.; GitHub Pages is not enabled on the repo (gh api 404, checked 2026-08-27) — deploy workflow needs Dave to flip Settings → Pages → source: GitHub Actions.
